Form 140 line 12 federal AGI 54,750.00; line 13 small business income 0.00; line 14 = 54,750.00. Line 15 non-Arizona municipal interest 0.00; lines 16-18 0.00; line 19 = 54,750.00 + 0.00 = 54,750.00. Line 35 = 54,750.00 - 0.00 = 54,750.00; line 36 other subtractions 0.00; line 37 = 54,750.00. Line 38 age 65 or over: box 8 = 0 x 2,100.00 = 0.00; lines 39-41 0.00. Line 42 Arizona adjusted gross income = 54,750.00 - 0.00 = 54,750.00. Line 43 standard deduction (single) 15,750.00; line 44 0.00. Line 45 Arizona taxable income = 54,750.00 - 15,750.00 = 39,000.00. Line 46 tax = 39,000.00 x 2.5% = 975.00. Lines 47-51 0.00 (no recapture, no dependents; family income credit: Worksheet I line 8 = 54,750.00, over the maximum for the status).
